claims.text: Contract number HHM402-08-C-0072; contract signed 22 September 2008; awarded off solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 (posted 18 Aug 2008, responses due 5 Sep 2008). Modification P00001 effective 02 September 2009 exercised/continued the effort.

DIA's own 16 December 2008 status briefing is headed 'Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Contract Status — Contract HHM402-08-C-0072' and describes the contract focus as 'Advanced (unconventional) aerospace weapon' technologies.

The contract does not appear in public federal contract data: an FPDS-NG ATOM query for PIID "HHM402-08-C-0072" returns an empty result feed, and USAspending.gov returns 404 for the corresponding generated award IDs.

Absence from FPDS/USAspending is expected for DIA Virginia Contracting Activity awards (intelligence-community contracting is generally excluded from public reporting), but it means the only public award record for a $22M program is the FOIA-released paper. Dollar-value line items on the modification are illegible/redacted in the released scan.
